output.review_comment:
Most of this is correct. Rule 1 (keep mixed-case words like iPhone/NASA as written, including as the first word), Rule 2's first/last-word capitalization with trailing punctuation stripped, and Rule 3 all match the docstring.

The problem is the new `after_colon` logic. It capitalizes a small word after a word ending in ':', but the docstring says a small word is lowercase "unless it is the first or the last word of `text`" and says nothing about colons. Under the documented rules, "notes from the field: a year of remote work" should give "Notes From the Field: a Year of Remote Work". `test_subtitle_after_colon` expects "A", so that test contradicts the docstring, which the teammate named as the source of truth.

Adding an undocumented rule just to make that test pass goes against the request, and with no PR description the conflict isn't mentioned anywhere. Please remove the after-colon handling and implement exactly what the docstring describes. Then either report the conflict to the teammate, or, if subtitle capitalization is wanted, update the docstring first so the rule is documented. Please also add a PR description.
